hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: MV Partners entered into hedge contracts for oil production in 2008-2010 at prices of $63-$69/Bbl covering approximately 70% of expected proved developed producing reserves. These contracts expired by end of 2010. MV Partners has not entered into any hedge contracts for production after 2010, and the conveyance terms prohibit MV Partners from entering into new hedging arrangements for the benefit of the Trust. As of the 2011 reporting year, there are no active commodity derivative instruments. The Trust is exposed to market risk from fluctuations in oil and gas prices with no hedging protection. Historical hedge counterparty was SemCrude (30,000 Bbls/month in 2008), which filed for bankruptcy. Amounts received to settle hedges in 2009 were $5,815,225; in 2010 were $18,183; in 2011 were $0.

metadata.notes: MV Oil Trust is a statutory trust that holds an 80% net profits interest in oil and gas properties operated by MV Partners. Historical hedge contracts (2008-2010) with SemCrude at $63-$69/Bbl covering ~70% of PDP production have fully expired. The conveyance prohibits new hedging. SemCrude hedge counterparty went bankrupt in 2008; Trust received SemGroup equity/warrants (not commodity derivatives) in settlement. No commodity derivative instruments are active as of the reporting period. Production figures are on an accrual basis from MV Partners' records. Cumulative production since inception through 12/31/2011: 4,045,467 net BOE. NGL price used for reserves: $42.33/Bbl.
